base_envelope_shape.edges: must be a list of generic role-bearing edge objects before spec_id dispatch
base_envelope_shape.ordering: base shape validation precedes supported/unsupported spec_id classification
base_envelope_shape.string_members: spec_id, artifact_type, and version must be nonempty strings

closure_algorithm: derive the direct operational role map from record mode/family and pinned validator configuration
require the signed trace operational_reference_map to equal that derived map
resolve each hash from the immutable ArtifactIndex snapshot
validate every direct field role against expected type, version and semantic discriminator
walk role-bearing edges breadth-first with cycle detection
validate parent type plus edge role plus declared child type against the pinned relation
validate the resolved child envelope type when expected_type is not opaque-content
require resolved_evidence_hashes to equal the fixed-point closure

edge_shape.expected_type: must equal the pinned parent-type/role relation
edge_shape.sha256: content address of the child artifact

envelope_classification_order: artifact without artifact_envelope is an opaque leaf
validate the complete generic EnvelopeShape before inspecting whether spec_id is supported
artifact_envelope missing or mistyping any required member or generic edge member is malformed and fails
shape-valid envelope with unsupported spec_id is unknown and blocks admission
